name: Church Vision
overview: Scripture reveals that a clear, God-given vision is essential for the health and direction of the church, as Proverbs 29:18 warns that without vision, people perish. God commands that this vision be clearly written and made plain so that it can be faithfully followed (Habakkuk 2:2). The church’s vision is centered on the Great Commission to make disciples of all nations (Matthew 28:19), empowered by the Holy Spirit to be witnesses everywhere (Acts 1:8). This vision also includes preaching the gospel to the brokenhearted and setting the captives free, following Christ’s example of ministry (Luke 4:18), and requires boldness to speak and act without fear as God directs (Acts 18:9).
